trap.label: past perfect (produção)
trap.wrong: When I arrived home, Mom baked the cake and I didn’t make the icing yet.
trap.right: When I arrived home, Mom had baked the cake and I hadn’t made the icing yet.
trap.why: Em português “quando cheguei, ela assou” é aceito. Em inglês o fato anterior vai no Past Perfect; já e ainda (already/yet) combinam com had.

mcq.q: Mom ___ the cake before I arrived.

fix.wrong: I didn’t finish when she called.
fix.right: I hadn’t finished when she called.

fix.wrong: She had not make it yet.
fix.right: She had not made it yet.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com already: “They ate before I arrived.”
rewrite.answer: They had already eaten before I arrived.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva negativa com yet: “I made the icing.”
rewrite.answer: I hadn't made the icing yet.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no Past Perfect: “Mom baked the cake.”
